components.css: .ds-masthead { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; column-gap: 2rem; min-height: 3.5rem; padding-inline: 1.5rem; background: var(--term-bg); color: var(--term-dim); font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.625rem; padding-block: 0.875rem; color: var(--term-fg); font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: -0.01em; text-decoration: none; } .ds-mark { width: 1.75rem; height: auto; } .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0 1.5rem; } .ds-nav a { position: relative; display: block; padding-block: 1.125rem; color: var(--term-dim); font-size: 0.9375rem; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--term-fg); } .ds-nav a[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--term-green); } .ds-masthead a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--term-focus); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-here { position: absolute; bottom: 0.4375rem; left: 50%; display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 2px; height: 6px; transform: translateX(-50%); } .ds-here i { width: 3px; border-radius: 1px; background: var(--term-green); } .ds-here i:nth-child(1) { height: 45%; } .ds-here i:nth-child(2) { height: 100%; } .ds-here i:nth-child(3) { height: 73%; }

components.name: Terminal panel
components.description: The brand line on Home: window dots, a dim $ and a green command. Not code, no Copy button.
components.html: $ sudo play --genre rock --mood debugging
components.css: .ds-panel { padding: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 1.5rem) clamp(1.25rem, 4vw, 2.5rem) clamp(1.75rem, 5vw, 3rem); border: 1px solid var(--term-edge); border-radius: 16px; background: var(--term-bg); } .ds-dots { display: flex; gap: 7px; margin-bottom: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 2.5rem); } .ds-dots i { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--term-dots); } .ds-line { margin: 0; color: var(--term-green); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: clamp(1.375rem, 0.9rem + 2.2vw, 2.375rem); font-variant-ligatures: none; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-word { white-space: nowrap; } .ds-prompt { color: var(--term-dim); }

components.name: Code block
components.description: Real code to type or paste: a labelled light block in light mode, with a Copy button added by script.
components.css: .ds-code { position: relative; margin: 1.5rem 0; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--bg-subtle); } .ds-code figcaption { padding: 0.625rem 6.5rem 0.625rem 1.25rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--fg-muted); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-code pre { margin: 0; padding: 1rem 1.25rem; overflow-x: auto; color: var(--fg); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.65; font-variant-ligatures: none; scrollbar-color: var(--border-strong) transparent; scrollbar-width: thin; } .ds-code-actions { position: absolute; top: 0.3125rem; right: 0.5rem; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-copy-status { color: var(--fg-muted); font-size: 0.75rem; }

narrative.overview:
The site is the app's menu bar popover, widened into a document. The app's composition carries over as the frame: a dark terminal band on top, a quiet light body below. The band holds the mark and the navigation on every page. On Home it grows into the full terminal panel with the brand line at display size. Everything under the band is a plain reading column.

The brand lives in the frame, never in the text. Running text is the system sans in a 66ch column on a plain page. Mono appears in three places only: the panel, code, and small labels. The page is flat and still. There are no shadows, no motion and no syntax colours, and one green that only ever means "act here" or "you are here".

Light and dark follow `prefers-color-scheme`, with no toggle. The band and the panel are dark in both modes. Code blocks follow the page, so in light mode they are light, and the dark panel stays the one dark object that means identity.
keyCharacteristics: A dark band (56px) in both modes, with the mark, the name and one row of nav
One emerald accent; zinc neutrals with a faint cool violet cast
System sans for reading, Geist Mono for the panel, code and labels
Flat, borders instead of shadows, nothing moves
Six pages read in order, with previous and next at the end of each

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: Green means "act here" or "you are here". It never decorates: no green headings, rules, icons or syntax colours.

rules.name: The Own Hues Rule
rules.body: These tokens are the only colours. Zinc sits at hue 286 and emerald at 163; never mix in another grey or green.

rules.name: The Dim Text Rule
rules.body: On a dark ground, muted text is `#9f9fa9`, never `#71717b`. Strong Zinc is a border colour there, not a text colour.

rules.name: The Mono in Three Places Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono sets the panel, code and small labels. Nothing else.

rules.name: The No Ligatures Rule
rules.body: Mono text sets `font-variant-ligatures: none`, so `=>` and `--` stay as typed.

rules.name: The Flat Page Rule
rules.body: Separate with tone and a hairline, never a shadow.

rules.name: The Still Page Rule
rules.body: Nothing moves, Home included. No transitions, no load animation.

dos: Do keep the band about 56px on inner pages. Only Home grows it.
Do mark the current page with `term-green` and the three bars, and nothing else.
Do set real code in a Code Block with a label, light in light mode.
Do keep the brand line in the Terminal Panel, wrapping between words.
Do keep running text in the system sans, in the 66ch column.
Do author focus: 2px `focus` outline at 2px offset, `term-focus` inside the band and the panel.
Do check every new layout at 320px for horizontal scroll.
donts: Don't set running text in mono or make the page dark. The dark ground belongs to the band and the panel only.
Don't give the tagline a Copy button or a code block, or present it as something to type.
Don't use green, or any colour, as decoration or as syntax highlighting.
Don't add a shadow, a transition or an animation.
Don't add a sidebar, a hamburger menu or JavaScript for navigation.
Don't load a font, icon or script from another host. Fonts are self hosted.
